name: Harness repairer
design: Very tall gaunt older male Yautja, charcoal and olive hide with pale facial speckling, long broad back-swept cranium and four separated asymmetric mandibles; long scalp tendrils with sparse brass cuffs. Heavy tan leather chest apron over dark green fitted tunic, riveted tool belt with small repair tools. Holds a loose folded leather harness close to torso with both hands. Relaxed sloping shoulders, no blades or weapons.
